segments.he: (צט) אָמַרטוֹב מְאד לִרְאוֹת פְּנֵי כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים  שֶׁבַּדּוֹר,  כִּי  צַדִּיקַיָּא  אַנְפֵּי  שְׁכִינְתָּא
segments.en: (99.) He said: "It is very good to see the faces of all the tzaddikim of the generation — for 'tzaddikim are the face of the Shechina'" [holy Zohar, Shemos 163b].
